QuestInfo.name: Darkness on Our Side
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2151003##k wants to speak with you about missions.\nGo to #b#m310010000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151003# told you that the Resistance mainly operates under cover of darkness. That means too much light can foil their plans. You are to get rid of 50 #r#o2150002#s#k in #b#m310030310##k.
QuestInfo.2: Without those lights, night missions should go much more smoothly.

0.0: Ah, #h0#, I'm glad to see you. I've come up with a way to improve our missions. Would you like to hear more?

yes.0: As you know, Resistance members run missions at night, to remain hidden, but all the streelights make this very difficult. For the sake of our agents, those streetlights must be removed!

no.0: Oh... Are you busy? That's too bad... But, do come back when you have time.

yes.0: Because of you, the Resistance's night missions will go much more smoothly! Great job!

mob.0: There are still too many streetlights at night. I need #r50 #o2150002#s#k in #b#m310030310##k taken out.
